function.name: reelix_music
function.description: Look up songs on Reelix Music. Use this when the user asks to search for a song, artist, or album, wants track details, or wants to play/send a track. Start with action=search (returns structured JSON; Audiomack by default, or pass source=youtube|spotify). Then call action=details with the trackId for cover art plus title and artist. Use action=stream with that trackId to send the track as an mp3 audio file. Never invent tracks that were not returned. Do not mention stream URLs.

query.description: Search query for action=search, for example Blinding Lights or Wizkid.

trackId.description: Track id from a search result. Required for details and stream.

source.description: youtube, spotify, or audiomack. Optional; the proxy default is audiomack.

type.description: Search type: song, album, artist, playlist, or all. Default song.
